summary.text: In September and October 2026, Michael described superintelligence as a source of new industries and said he wanted the transformative technology to serve all Americans. On May 20, 2026, he advocated embedding AI in military systems to improve speed, precision, decision-making, and protection of warfighters. In a 2025 event excerpt, he urged ensuring that locally proposed rules did not slow companies down.

stance_review.reason: The supplied evidence includes positive general views about superintelligence's economic potential and service to Americans. Most other statements concern military applications, particular companies, regulation, or competitive leadership rather than AI's overall effects. The supplied source contexts for s7, s17, and s50 were reviewed; other excerpts were assessed without assuming omitted content. National-dominance and frontier rhetoric alone, including s52, was not treated as an overall-benefit stance.
